name: SaunaLife CL5G 4-Person Cube-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit
description: 4-Person Cube-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit CL5G Experience the pinnacle of contemporary sauna design with the SaunaLife Cube-Series Model CL5G, engineered for four-person capacity. This outdoor sauna kit combines Nordic aesthetics with functional elegance, featuring an expansive glass facade that frames the generously proportioned interior. Standing taller than 6'2", the design accommodates multiple bathers comfortably while maintaining the refined simplicity characteristic of Scandinavian craftsmanship—an ideal addition for those seeking authentic sauna wellness in a sophisticated, space-efficient package. Exquisite Modern Design: Scandinavian Aesthetics: The Cube-Series Model CL5G features a sleek Scandinavian design that combines elegance with simplicity. Its clean lines and minimalist style create a sophisticated look that enhances any outdoor setting. Full-Glass Front: The striking full-glass front not only adds a touch of elegance but also provides a panoramic view of the surroundings, seamlessly blending indoor comfort with the beauty of nature. Spacious and Comfortable: Ample Room: With a height of over 6’2” and a spacious interior, the CL5G comfortably accommodates up to 4 bathers. This makes it ideal for enjoying the sauna experience with family and friends. Ergonomic Design: Thoughtfully designed for maximum comfort, the sauna includes ergonomic backrests and seating arrangements that support proper posture and relaxation. High-Quality Construction: Thermo-Spruce Exterior: The sauna features a beautiful and durable Thermo-Spruce exterior, known for its excellent heat resistance and longevity. This material not only ensures the sauna's durability but also gives it a natural, appealing look. Airflow Circulation: The construction supports optimal airflow circulation, ensuring a consistent and pleasant sauna experience by maintaining ideal temperature and humidity levels. Enhanced Features: Ergonomic Backrests: Enjoy additional comfort with specially designed backrests that provide support and enhance the overall relaxation experience. Shapely Design: The inviting, shapely design of the CL5G draws you in, creating a cozy and intimate environment that encourages relaxation and rejuvenation. The SaunaLife Cube-Series Model CL5G is more than just an outdoor sauna; it’s a luxurious retreat designed to elevate your outdoor living experience. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or share a rejuvenating session with loved ones, the CL5G offers the perfect sanctuary. Transform your outdoor space with the elegance and functionality of the CL5G and enjoy the timeless benefits of sauna bathing. The CL5G Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping. Please share any extenuating delivery circumstances that may complicate or cause additional delivery expenses. Our goal is to ensure your project’s success. If your order is in stock and we process the charges to your credit card, it will ship within five business days from the date of your order. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . No shipping outside the lower 48 States in the USA. What if my shipment is damaged? Please inspect the packaging of your item(s) when they arrive. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf. Your warranty will guarantee you a fully functional and operational product. If it is unclear whether your order is custom or made to order, please message or call us.
